scope: Proposition 12.2 of the manuscript “Boundary graph deformations for the spacetime Penrose inequality” (preprints/Boundary-graph-deformations-for-the-spacetime-Penrose-inequality-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4205f51d8f1b130b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 94. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix the prepared data, ϵ, a sufficiently large N and any stage of the homotopy. Every smooth solution on an allowed finite truncation ΩR with t ≥ −ϵ has uniform local estimates for every finite number of derivatives of f and Z, up to both the inner and outer boundary faces. The constants on the fixed compact part and on uniform unit patches of the end are independent of R and of the homotopy parameters. They may depend arbitrarily on N. On each fixed finite truncation they therefore bound ∥Z∥C1,α0 for every prescribed 0 < α0 < 1.
